newsitem.title: USA: Nash Finch to buy Nebraska distributor.
newsitem.headline: Nash Finch to buy Nebraska distributor.

text.p: Nash Finch Co said Tuesday it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the business and assets of United-A.G. Cooperative Inc, a cooperative wholesale grocery distributor located in Omaha, Neb.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in June, subject to approval by United-A.G.'s shareholder members, regulatory clearance and satisfaction of customary closing conditions.
Under the agreement, Nash Finch will acquire substantially all of the assets of United-A.G., its distribution center in Omaha, for cash. Additional terms were not disclosed.
United-A.G. had 1996 revenues of about $200 million and serves approximately 100 member-owned stores in Nebraska, Kansas, Iowa, Colorado and South Dakota, Nash Finch said.
Nash Finch is a food wholesaler, supplying products to affiliated and independent supermarkets, other independent retailers and military bases in approximately 30 states.
